title: Professional Certificate Course in Human AI Interaction
description: To equip learners with the knowledge and practical skills to effectively and ethically interact, collaborate, and work alongside Artificial Intelligence systems.
longDescription: Explain the principles of Human–AI Interaction and the role of AI in supporting human decision-making. Evaluate the impact of AI on human behavior, communication, productivity, and workplace collaboration. Apply human-centered design principles to improve user experiences with AI-enabled systems. Assess the ethical, social, and privacy considerations associated with Human–AI interaction. Demonstrate effective strategies for collaborating with AI tools to enhance professional and organizational performance. This course explores the dynamic relationship between humans and Artificial Intelligence, focusing on effective collaboration, communication, and decision-making. It examines human-centered AI design, user experience, trust, ethics, and responsible AI adoption across diverse industries. Learners will develop practical skills to work alongside AI technologies while understanding their capabilities and limitations. The course prepares participants to leverage AI responsibly to enhance productivity, innovation, and human performance.
